rationale.overall: B is the closer overall match to the REFERENCE because its slab reads more volumetric and matte, its curl keeps lit/shadowed translucency, and its ground split keeps a textured-versus-smooth polarity.
rationale.material: B’s semi-matte dark block with clearer top-to-side falloff, a thin curl with an inner shaded face and grain, and a rough/smooth ground contrast track the REFERENCE’s volumetric shading and translucency better than A’s flatter, more opaque curl and glossier panel read.
rationale.silhouette: Both takes share the same diagonal rounded block, upper-left loop, orange rim, and squircle crop, so the figure–ground silhouette is effectively identical.
rationale.smallsize: At 128px and in the 32/16px magnifications both collapse to the same dark diagonal mass, a few surviving orange rim pixels, and a near-lost curl smudge with no clear legibility edge.
